en.title: B
en.summary: The letter name is Be, as in the word Buch.

sections.title: Sound of Be
paragraphs: The letter name is (Be) /beː/. Its main sound is heard in the word (Buch) /buːx/, which means book. This letter makes two sounds in German.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly to stop the air. Then open them quickly to release it. Turn your voice on so your throat vibrates. For the other sound, keep the same mouth shape. Close both lips, but turn your voice off completely. Put your fingers on your throat to feel the buzz stop.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: At the start of a word or syllable before a vowel, this letter sounds voiced as in (Ball) /bal/. At the end of a word or syllable, the voice turns off. You hear this voiceless sound in (ab) /ap/ and in (gelb) /ɡɛlp/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not let your voice run at the end of words. When a word ends with this letter, say it like the p in cup. Turn your voice off completely so it does not sound like English cab.
